targets.expr: max(dag_global_snapshot_ordinal{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} and (time() - dag_global_snapshot_last_updated_epoch{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} < 120)) - min(dag_global_snapshot_ordinal{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} and (time() - dag_global_snapshot_last_updated_epoch{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} < 120))

max(dag_global_snapshot_tips_count{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id", tip_type="active"} and (time() - dag_global_snapshot_last_updated_epoch{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} < 120))

min(dag_global_snapshot_tips_count{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id", tip_type="active"} and (time() - dag_global_snapshot_last_updated_epoch{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} < 120))

max(dag_global_snapshot_tips_count{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id", tip_type="deprecated"} and (time() - dag_global_snapshot_last_updated_epoch{application=~"$application", ip=~"$ip", peer_id=~"$peer_id"} < 120))
